name: getDoctorAvailability
shortDescription: Retrieves a doctor's availability schedule, considering their set working hours and existing appointments.
description:
Overview

Fetches the detailed availability schedule for a specified doctor, taking into account their configured working hours and any pre-existing appointments.

Intended use

Called by the patient-facing UI during appointment scheduling or by the doctor-facing UI for schedule review. It requires doctorId and an optional date range.

Logic

  1. Retrieve the Doctor entity using params.doctorId.
  2. Parse the Doctor.availabilitySchedule (expected to be in JSON format) to determine the doctor's base working hours.
  3. Query Appointment entities for the specified doctorId within a given date range (e.g., next two weeks) using ctx.data.query, filtering by status not equal to 'cancelled'.
  4. Cross-reference the doctor's base availability with the existing appointments to identify and mark free and booked time slots.
  5. Return a structured list of available and unavailable time slots.

Entities

  • Doctor
  • Appointment
